rationale: This is unambiguously an auto collision claim: motor vehicle damage (totaled vehicle) and minor injury (whiplash, sprained wrist) arising directly from a vehicle collision.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday by another vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle (trunk crushed into back seat) and injuries to the policyholder (whiplash and sprained wrist). Police report filed with other driver's insurance information available.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.injury_party: policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist
case_facts.police_report: yes, other driver's insurance information on file
